First, I want to modify a few items: I’d like the desk lamp changed to black, and the backpack changed to a medium size in polyester—if it comes in multiple colors, I’d prefer grey. Also, I accidentally sent the order to my son’s address in Washington, DC, and I need it changed back to my regular address. My name is Ivan Khan, and my zip code is 28243.
